source_window.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government / Planning Data; source organisation Exeter City Council

first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public physical building-footprint Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry for The Crawford Hotel, Exeter. Planning Data entity 7010010043 publishes an authoritative MultiPolygon and explicit Hotel identity/type-use evidence, but the record dataset is article-4-direction-area and its description defines a demolition/planning-control area at the Crawford Hotel rather than a physical building footprint; therefore the physical-footprint acceptance criterion is not satisfied and no individual building record was accepted.
